bank.title: Bank verification
bank.pending: Eligibility date pending — the certificate issue date is missing.

dbd.title: DBD records
dbd.dateHint: As printed on the certificate, e.g. 9 เมษายน 2569, 09/04/2569 or 9 April 2026
dbd.directorsHint: One director per line: Thai name | English name

errors.upload-failed: The file could not be uploaded (connection lost or not a PDF). Please try again.
errors.invalid-file: Only PDF files up to 30 MB are accepted (6 files at most)

dbd.extracted: Extraction complete — review the suggested values below, then save and confirm.
dbd.extractHint: Reads the uploaded certificate again and fills only fields that are still empty.
dbd.extractionNotConfigured: AI extraction is not configured (set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
dbd.reviewSuggestions: Suggested values from the certificate are shown where the record is still empty. Check every field — especially highlighted ones — then Save and Confirm.

extractErrors.provider: The extraction service failed. Try again later.
extractErrors.invalid_output: The extraction result was not usable.
extractErrors.too_large: The documents exceed 30 MB in total; split or compress them

dbd.uploadFirstHint: Choose the Thai PDFs (several at once: certificate, objectives sheet, Bor.Or.Jor.5, Bor.Or.Jor.2). The documents are read and all three levels are filled in automatically; you then review, correct if needed, and confirm.
dbd.uploadFirstNoExtraction: Document reading is not configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY required). The file is stored and you fill in the fields below yourself.
dbd.uploadFillsHint: Add more DBD documents (certificate, objectives sheet, Bor.Or.Jor.5, Bor.Or.Jor.2); every file is read and only empty fields are filled.
dbd.orEnterManually: Or enter the details manually without a file
dbd.uploadedButNotRead: The file was uploaded but could not be read ({reason}). Fill the fields yourself or try reading again.

levels.business: Level 2 — Business profile (objectives sheet / Bor.Or.Jor.5 / Bor.Or.Jor.2)
levels.interview: Level 4 — Bank interview answers (facts the DBD does not hold)

dbd.objectivesHint: One objective per line; a leading number is kept, e.g. "1. To operate…"
dbd.shareholdersHint: One per line: name | nationality | shares
dbd.fileHint: PDF, up to 30 MB per file
dbd.interviewHint: The bank asks these too, but no DBD document answers them. Enter the answers the company prepared; they feed the study cards, quiz, exam and call practice.

interviewFields.account_purpose: Why does the company need a bank account?

index.label: Search index
index.hint: Documents are read five pages at a time in the background (about a minute per run); reload to refresh the status.
index.removeUnavailable: The document was kept: the search index (Pinecone) is unreachable, so its vectors could not be removed first. Try again later.

ask.title: Ask the documents
ask.hint: Answers come only from the uploaded documents, with the page — use it to check what was read.
ask.placeholder: e.g. What is the registered capital? / Who holds shares?

errors.not_indexed: The documents are not indexed yet — wait until the status is "Ready"

ask.noAnswer: No model answer available; showing the passages found

dbd.deferredFill: The documents are too long to read in one pass; they are being read in the background and the fields will fill in when the index status is "Ready" (reload to see them).
dbd.readingQueued: The documents are being read in the background (about 1–3 minutes); reload the page to see the filled fields.
dbd.readingFailed: The documents could not be read ({reason}). Fill the fields yourself or click "Read the document again".

errors.already-assigned: This learner already has an active assignment
errors.not-confirmed: Only confirmed records can be assigned

content.title: Study content
content.bodyHint: Headings, lists, bold and links are supported. No HTML.
content.starterLoaded: {count} new card(s) added (existing ones were left unchanged)

questions.title: Question bank
questions.approvalHint: Approval requires Thai, English and Chinese versions. Only approved, active questions are served.
questions.placeholderHint: Placeholders you can use (distractor variants after a pipe):
questions.fillMissingHint: Missing: {languages}. Translated from the existing language, keeping '{...}' variables and options unchanged.

fillErrors.provider: The AI provider returned an error. Try again.
fillErrors.invalid_output: The AI returned an invalid result. Try again.
fillErrors.no_material: Write at least one language first

settings.title: Policy settings
settings.intro: These values drive the business rules (policy_config). Every change is audited with the admin who made it.

bank_eligibility_days.label: Days before the bank stage opens
bank_eligibility_days.help: Counted from the certificate issue date (BR-002, default 45). Changing it recomputes every learner's date.

bank_access_expiry_days.label: Days the bank stage stays open
bank_access_expiry_days.help: Counted from the opening date; blank = never expires

exam_retry_wait_hours.label: Hours to wait before retaking the exam

exam_pass_rule.label: Exam pass rule
exam_pass_rule.help: Which result decides the passed status

require_exam_pass_for_name_card.label: Require exam pass for the name card
require_exam_pass_for_name_card.help: When on, learners must pass the exam before creating a card

require_exam_pass_for_bank_call.label: Require exam pass for the bank call
require_exam_pass_for_bank_call.help: When on, learners must pass the exam before practising calls (default: on)

study_completion_tracking.label: Study completion rule
study_completion_tracking.help: Count a card when viewed, or only when the learner marks it completed

generate.title: Generate questions with AI
generate.intro: Questions are grounded in the DBD company certificate. Pick a reference certificate and a count; the model drafts multiple-choice questions in Thai, English and Chinese, using variables so each learner is asked about their own company. Everything stays a draft until you review and approve it.
generate.fakeNotice: Test mode: no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, so sample questions are generated instead.
generate.materialHint: Optional extra material for general-knowledge questions: tick study cards, paste text, or upload a file.
generate.pastedHint: Paste notes, lesson content, or your existing draft questions…
generate.fileHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD (max 20 MB)
generate.templateCount: Of which ask facts from the learner's certificate
generate.templateHint: Defaults to all; the rest test understanding of the document itself.
generate.focusHint: e.g. emphasise what bank officers ask

errors.not_configured: AI is not configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY required). Contact an admin.
errors.provider: The AI provider returned an error. Try again.
errors.invalid_output: The AI returned an invalid result. Try again.
errors.no_material: Pick a study card, paste text, or upload a file
errors.nothing_produced: No question passed validation. Try again.

generate.referenceHint: The AI reads this certificate's particulars (and its PDF when uploaded) to ask about the real facts, but never copies its values into a question — every question uses variables so each learner is asked about their own company.

role.title: The learner's role in the company
role.hint: The bank asks "how many shares do you hold?", "what is your position?" — the portal needs to know who this learner is in the DBD documents.
role.holderName: Name as in the DBD documents
role.holderHint: Pick from the directors/shareholders or type it; used to match the learner's shareholding.

study.title: Study material
study.notAvailable: Not available in this language yet
study.openPdf: Open PDF in a new tab
study.pdfMissing: The PDF for this language has not been uploaded yet.

evidence.title: From your documents
evidence.hint: The actual text of your company's DBD documents for this topic — compare it with your prepared answers.

quiz.title: Evaluation quiz
quiz.intro: Practice questions about your company and the process. You see whether each answer is right immediately, with an explanation, and a full review at the end.

bankCall.title: Bank verification call training
bankCall.intro: A simulated bank officer calls you in Thai and asks about your company. Answer from your DBD certificate. The conversation is recorded for admin review.

tips.quiet: Find a quiet place and use headphones if you can
tips.microphone: Allow the browser to use your microphone when asked
tips.facts: Have the company name, head office address, registered capital and directors ready

bankCall.simulate: Simulate the call to the end
bankCall.fakeHint: Test mode: no call provider is configured, so a sample transcript is stored instead.
